errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the chart is about 'assessments of connectedness in remote work'. The chart's title is 'В офиса съм по-мотивиран/а да работя' which translates to 'I am more motivated to work in the office'.
The description omits that the x-axis categories are grouped by gender ('Жена' - Woman, 'Мъж' - Man) within each age group. It only mentions the age groups.
The description claims the y-axis has a label 'Процент' (Percentage), but the axis in the figure has no label.

errors.text_span: стойностите са подредени в намаляващ ред от ляво надясно
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the values (bars) are sorted in decreasing order. The bars within each group are ordered by the five response categories from the legend, not by their height.

The description incorrectly attributes the highest bar (57%) to 'Жени' (Women). In the chart, the 57% bar corresponds to 'Мъж' (Men) in the 45+ age group for the 'Не мога да преценя' (Cannot judge) category.

The description translates the legend item '3 Не мога да преценя' (3 - Cannot judge) as '3 - Не съм сигурен' (3 - I'm not sure). While the meaning is similar, it is not an accurate transcription of the legend text.

errors.text_span: стълбовете за жени показват оранжево, а тези за мъже - синьо
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that colors represent gender (orange for women, blue for men). The colors actually represent the five different levels of agreement for all genders, as shown in the legend.
